Fine. So $\tan R$ is opposite over adjacent, which is $PQ/PR$. And $\sin R$ is opposite over hypotenuse, which is $PQ/20$. So $PQ/PR = 4(PQ/20)$. Is that the right way to set it up?
Your setup of the trigonometric ratios and the substitution into the equation is correct. Now, think about how to isolate $PR$ from that equation. What can you do with the $PQ$ terms on both sides?
